diff:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index bd617b7..06c0a0a 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -3,3 +3,5 @@
 Fetch JSON from a URL and print it.
 
     fetchit https://api.example.com/items --timeout 5
+
+Output is syntax-coloured when stdout is a terminal (uses pygments).
diff --git a/fetchit/cli.py b/fetchit/cli.py
index ddbc0bd..f765db4 100644
--- a/fetchit/cli.py
+++ b/fetchit/cli.py
@@ -15,7 +15,14 @@ def main(argv=None) -> int:
     except FetchError as e:
         print(e, file=sys.stderr)
         return 1
-    print(json.dumps(data, indent=2))
+    text = json.dumps(data, indent=2)
+    if sys.stdout.isatty():
+        from pygments import highlight
+        from pygments.formatters import TerminalFormatter
+        from pygments.lexers import JsonLexer
+
+        text = highlight(text, JsonLexer(), TerminalFormatter()).rstrip("\n")
+    print(text)
     return 0
 
 
diff --git a/pyproject.toml b/pyproject.toml
index 144bd87..70621a6 100644
--- a/pyproject.toml
+++ b/pyproject.toml
@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@ name = "fetchit"
 version = "0.2.0"
 description = "Fetch JSON from a URL"
 requires-python = ">=3.10"
-dependencies = []
+dependencies = ["pygments"]
 
 [project.scripts]
 fetchit = "fetchit.cli:main"
diff --git a/requirements.txt b/requirements.txt
index a15de0e..7cda995 100644
--- a/requirements.txt
+++ b/requirements.txt
@@ -1 +1,2 @@
 # Runtime dependencies, one per line.
+pygments
